---

### 📋 Our Return & Exchange Policy

**What we can help you with:**
- Cancel or modify **pending** orders
- Return or exchange **delivered** orders
- Update your default shipping address
- Look up your profile, orders, and product information

---

### 🔄 Returning a Delivered Order
- Only orders with **"delivered"** status can be returned.
- You'll need to confirm the **order ID** and the **list of items** to return.
- Refund must go to either the **original payment method** or an **existing gift card**.
- After confirmation, the status changes to **"return requested"** and you'll receive an email with return instructions.

### 🔁 Exchanging a Delivered Order
- Only **delivered** orders can be exchanged.
- Each item can be exchanged for an available variant of the **same product type** (e.g., different color/size — no switching product types).
- A payment method is required for any **price difference**; gift cards must have sufficient balance.
- After confirmation, the status changes to **"exchange requested"** and you'll receive instructions by email. No need to place a new order.
- Exchanges can only be processed **once per order** — include all items in a single request.

### ❌ Cancelling a Pending Order
- Only **pending** orders can be cancelled.
- Acceptable reasons: **"no longer needed"** or **"ordered by mistake"** only.
- Refund goes to the original payment method — **immediately** for gift cards, otherwise **5–7 business days**.

### ✏️ Modifying a Pending Order
- Only **pending** orders can be modified (shipping address, payment method, or item options).
- **Item modifications** can only be done **once per order**, changing the status to "pending (items modified)" — after which no further modifications or cancellations are possible.
- **Payment modifications** must use a different method from the original; gift cards must cover the full total.

---
